title: Dataset Manifest
description: Catalogue entry for one DMI dataset: identity, lifecycle status, roles, retention, licence, archiving record and products. Aligned with the DMI Storage and Archiving Standard STD-STOR-ARCH-001 v1.0. Which fields are mandatory depends on `status` (allOf rules at the bottom): (1) active/archived/deprecated — every REQ-CAT-004 field that applies; 'TBD by YYYY-MM-DD' is accepted for facts and links not yet known (Procedure A.5), while roles, retention and licence are decisions that must be made; (2) archived — also an Owner-approved appraisal, WIS2 discipline, format, compression, quality check and archiving date, with no TBD left (REQ-ARC-001, REQ-APP-001–003, REQ-NAME-004, Procedure C.7); (3) deleted — deletion date and approver (REQ-CAT-007, REQ-RET-002); (4) third-party storage — the contract is linked (REQ-TPY-003).

location.description: An absolute path (/dmidata/…), a path on another server (host:/path), or a URL (scheme://…) for a database or external store. No trailing slash on a path, no spaces at either end.

relativePath.description: A path relative to dataset.path: no slash at the start or end, no spaces at either end.

id.title: Catalogue ID
id.description: Unique, stable identifier of this entry (REQ-CAT-003). Lower-case letters, digits, '-' and '_'. Must equal the manifest file name (<id>.yaml) and never change once registered.

status.title: Lifecycle status
status.description: Current state in the dataset lifecycle (Standard §4, Figure 1). The status decides which fields are mandatory.

name.title: Title
name.description: Short, human-readable name (REQ-CAT-004). Prefer names that survive reorganisation: 'Operational WAM', not 'John's wave model output'.

path.title: Location (primary path)
path.description: Where the authoritative copy lives, e.g. /dmidata/archive/ocean/… or /dmidata/projects/… (REQ-CAT-004): an absolute path without a trailing slash, host:/path on another server, or for database or third-party storage a URL (scheme://…).

description.title: Description
description.description: What the dataset contains, why it exists and how to interpret it — a few sentences (REQ-CAT-004). Detail belongs on the metadata page.

model.title: Model / source
model.description: Model system, instrument or source (e.g. NEMO, HARMONIE-AROME, EC-Earth3).

domain.title: Domain
domain.description: Geographic domain (e.g. North Sea - Baltic Sea, Global).

roles.title: Roles
roles.description: Every dataset has a named Data Owner, Data Steward and Data Custodian with reachable contacts (Standard §3). One person may hold all three — then say so explicitly.

owner.title: Data Owner
owner.description: Accountable: decides purpose, permitted use, retention and sharing; approves retention, archiving and deletion (REQ-OWN-001–003). When registry/owners.yaml lists approved Data Owners, the Owner must be one of them.

steward.title: Data Steward
steward.description: Responsible for this entry, documentation and quality; defines how the dataset is prepared for archiving (REQ-STW-001–004).

custodian.title: Data Custodian
custodian.description: Responsible for storage, permissions, quotas, write-protection and integrity (REQ-CUS-001–003). A team mailbox is fine.

single_person.title: One person holds all three roles
single_person.description: Must be ticked when Owner, Steward and Custodian are the same person (Standard §3).

retention.title: Retention
retention.description: How long the dataset is kept, and why (REQ-RET-001, approved by the Owner: REQ-OWN-002).

kind.title: Retain until
kind.description: A fixed date, a condition, or indefinitely (only with a written rationale).

condition.title: Retain until (condition)
condition.description: e.g. 'until superseded by the next reanalysis version, plus 2 years'.

rationale.title: Rationale
rationale.description: Why this retention: 'We keep X until Y because Z'. Mandatory for 'indefinite'.

license.title: Licence
license.description: The terms under which the dataset may be used (REQ-LIC-001, REQ-LIC-002).

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: Why access is limited. Mandatory for 'restricted'; recommended for 'DMI internal use only'.

decided_by.title: Restriction decided by
decided_by.description: The decision-maker for a restricted licence (REQ-LIC-002).

pid.title: Local persistent identifier (PID)
pid.description: Stable identifier that resolves to the dataset and survives moves and renames (REQ-CAT-008). The DMI PID arrangement is still being confirmed — ask the Data Custodian.

doi.title: DOI of this dataset
doi.description: This dataset's own DOI, registered via DataCite (REQ-CAT-009). Recommended for datasets that are cited, published or meant for long-term reuse. Bare DOI, without https://doi.org/. A DOI of something else — a product published from this data, a paper — goes under Related DOIs.

related.title: Related DOIs
related.description: DOIs of related works: products published from this data (e.g. a Copernicus Marine product), papers or reports describing it, or the data it was made from.

title.title: What it is
title.description: Short name or product code, e.g. 'BALTICSEA_MULTIYEAR_PHY_003_011' or 'Larsen et al. (2024)'.

relation.title: Relation
relation.description: How this dataset relates to the DOI, in DataCite terms.

metadata.title: Metadata page
metadata.description: Fuller description: what the dataset is, how it was produced, what the variables mean, known limitations (REQ-CAT-004, REQ-ARC-003).

archiving_guide.title: Archiving guide
archiving_guide.description: Step-by-step description of how this dataset is prepared and written to the archive: filtering, aggregation, format, size, compression (REQ-STW-002, REQ-ARC-002).

contract.title: Contract / agreement
contract.description: Written agreement covering security, access, retention and exit. Mandatory for third-party storage (REQ-TPY-002, REQ-TPY-003).

dates.title: Dates
dates.description: ISO 8601 dates (YYYY-MM-DD). Quote them in YAML.

released.title: Release date
released.description: When the dataset (or its current version) was published or put into use.

archived.title: Archiving date
archived.description: When the dataset moved to long-term storage. Mandatory once archived.

deletion_planned.title: Planned deletion date
deletion_planned.description: When defined. Deletion still needs the Owner's approval at the time (Procedure G).

reviewed.title: Last reviewed
reviewed.description: When the Steward last reviewed this entry. Recommended at least yearly (REQ-CAT-006, REQ-STW-004).

updated.title: Last updated
updated.description: Optional: when the data or this entry last changed.

tier.title: Storage tier
tier.description: Where the authoritative copy lives (Standard §5). Scratch is never the only home of a dataset (REQ-TIER-001).

wis2_discipline.title: WIS2 discipline
wis2_discipline.description: Top-level folder under /dmidata/archive (REQ-NAME-004). One discipline per archive folder (REQ-NAME-005). Mandatory once archived.

formats.title: File formats
formats.description: Every format of the files in the dataset, inside any containers. Open, documented formats only in the archive (REQ-FMT-001). Mandatory once archived.

format_notes.title: Format details
format_notes.description: What the list does not say: edition, conventions, proportions, or the name of an 'other' format, e.g. 'GRIB2', 'GHRSST L2P', 'mostly netCDF'. Mandatory when 'other' is chosen.

containers.title: Containers
containers.description: How files are packed together, if at all. squashfs is the container for mixed file types and when names and structure must be kept (REQ-CMP-002). Leave empty for plain files.

compression.title: Compression
compression.description: The algorithms used, inside files or containers; 'none' if uncompressed. zstd or zlib for netCDF, zstd for squashfs, xz case by case, gzip avoided (REQ-CMP-001–003). Mandatory once archived.

compression_settings.title: Compression settings
compression_settings.description: Tool and settings, e.g. 'mksquashfs -comp zstd -b 1M' or 'netCDF zlib level 1'. Mandatory when 'other' is chosen.

lossy.title: Lossy compression or precision reduction used
lossy.description: Only with the Owner's explicit approval and documented settings (REQ-FMT-003).

lossy_settings.title: Lossy settings
lossy_settings.description: The documented precision setting, e.g. 'bit-rounding, 7 keep-bits for t, u, v'.

secondary_locations.title: Secondary locations
secondary_locations.description: Other places the dataset is duplicated, if any (REQ-CAT-004), written like the primary location.

checksums.title: Integrity checksums
checksums.description: Where the checksums recorded at archiving are kept, e.g. 'sha256 files next to each archive file' (REQ-PRT-003).

appraisal.title: Appraisal
appraisal.description: The recorded decision that the dataset is worth preserving at all. Written by the Steward and approved by the Owner before the dataset is prepared for archiving (REQ-APP-001–004).

lasting_value.title: Why does it have lasting value?
lasting_value.description: One or two sentences: what would be lost if this dataset disappeared?

users.title: Who will use it?
users.description: The part of the Designated Community expected to use it.

regenerable.title: Could it be regenerated if lost?
regenerable.description: impossible (observations, changed inputs), expensive, or cheap — if cheap, keep the code and configuration rather than the data.

regeneration_notes.title: Regeneration notes
regeneration_notes.description: What regeneration would need (code, configuration, inputs) and roughly what it would cost.

obligations.title: Obligations and references
obligations.description: Recommended: arkivloven / Rigsarkivet rules, GDPR, contracts, citations or derived products, operational dependencies (REQ-APP-004).

quality_verified_on.title: Quality verified on
quality_verified_on.description: When the Steward verified completeness and quality: expected files present, no truncation, values in range, metadata accurate (REQ-STW-003, REQ-ARC-004). Mandatory once archived.

aggregation.title: Aggregation
aggregation.description: How files are aggregated to land in 5 GiB–5 TiB (preferred 10 GiB–2 TiB), e.g. 'monthly netCDF' (REQ-SIZE-001–003).

automated.title: Archived automatically (scheduled production)
automated.description: Scheduled production data kept long-term is archived by an automated process (REQ-OPS-001).

pipeline.title: Archiving job configuration
pipeline.description: Link to the documented, version-controlled job (REQ-OPS-002), normally in the DMI archive tool.

owning_team.title: Owning team
owning_team.description: Named team that owns the automated process and receives its alerts (REQ-OPS-002, Procedure D.4).

deletion.title: Deletion record
deletion.description: Deleted datasets keep their entry, marked as deleted (REQ-CAT-007, Procedure G.4).

approved_by.title: Approved by (Data Owner)
approved_by.description: Deletion is approved by the Owner and carried out by the Custodian (REQ-RET-002).

reference.title: Approval reference
reference.description: Ticket, e-mail or note recording the request and its execution.

rigsarkivet_authorisation.title: Rigsarkivet authorisation
rigsarkivet_authorisation.description: Needed in advance when the data has lasting value (REQ-RIG-002).

designated_community_notes.title: Notes for the Designated Community
designated_community_notes.description: Optional. Anything a future user would need to interpret the data: unusual conventions, provenance quirks, known limitations (Standard §4.2).

exceptions.title: Registered exceptions
exceptions.description: Deviations from SHALL requirements that are registered in the exception register, max. 12 months each (Standard §9).

extensions.title: Other information
extensions.description: Free-form information that has no field of its own (any keys and values). Not checked. Use the defined fields, product notes or designated_community_notes where they fit.

products.title: Products

dir.description: Path relative to dataset.path holding this product: usually a sub-directory, but a nested path (v0.6.0/analysis.zarr) or a single file or container (.sqfs image, Zarr store) also works.

dir_pattern.description: Shell glob pattern matching multiple subdirectories under dataset.path (e.g. 'n[0-9][0-9][0-4]'). Use instead of dir when a product spans many directories with a naming convention.

category.description: Grouping category. Common values: Physics, Biogeochemistry, Ice, Observations, Assimilation, Waves, Atmospheric. Climate datasets may use activity names (DECK, CMIP, ScenarioMIP, DCPP).

type.description: Role of this data in the processing chain. Intermediate and reproducible outputs should be filtered out before archiving (REQ-ARC-005).

products.description: Map of product key to product metadata. Each product lives in its own subdirectory (dir) or matches multiple directories (dir_pattern). Extra keys (e.g. experiment_id) are allowed.
